calls.transcript:
Genie: Hello, I'm an AI assistant from Refund Genie, calling on behalf of Demo Passenger, with their permission, about a refund for PNR SAMPLE.
Menu: For refunds, press 2.
Genie: [Pressed 2]
Menu: Please hold. [Hold music, 20 seconds]
Care: Please give the PNR.
Genie: SAMPLE. What is the refund status, processing date, who has the money, and reference?
Care: Demo Air paid Rs 5400 to DemoTrips on 2026-10-21. Airline reference DEMO-AIR-RG-BC9710. DemoTrips now has the refund.
Genie: Thank you. I will ask DemoTrips for the bank transfer reference. Goodbye.

mails.body:
Dear Grievance Officer,

Please check my Demo Air flight refund (PNR SAMPLE, booking ID TEST-ID). The cancellation date was 11 Sep 2026, and I paid Rs 5400.

DGCA refund rule, paragraph 3(c): the airline must complete travel-site refunds within 14 working days. The refund due date is 1 Oct 2026.

On which date did the airline pay this refund to you? Please share the complaint reference number.

Please reply to all on this mail and keep RG-BC9710 in the subject, so my records stay in one thread.

Thank you,
Demo Passenger
